name: Rachel Turner
original_name: レイチェル ターナー
source:
A girl who came to Japan alone to study, drawn by her admiration for Japanese samurai and ninja.
With a typically Western frank personality, she seems to click with Yakumo and wants to hang out with her after school too.

She fights possessed by the Divine Skeleton Princess Berid.
Her approach is pretty haphazard and her attack methods are sloppy. While she has the highest firepower among the members, her collateral damage is also high.
